visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with light skin and brown hair tied in a bun, wearing a white ribbed tank top, speaks directly to the camera in a brightly lit indoor room. (2) A photograph of K-pop star Jennie is displayed, showing her holding a red rose. (3) The woman is in a bathroom setting; she fills a white bowl with ice water from a dispenser and then fully submerges her face into the bowl before drying it with a white towel. (4) A photograph of K-pop star IU is shown, where she is making a heart shape with her hands. (5) The woman demonstrates a face-washing routine in front of a bathroom mirror, applying foaming cleanser, massaging her face, rinsing with water, and patting dry with a towel. (6) A digital collage appears featuring various Korean celebrities using electronic beauty devices in different settings. (7) The woman holds two pink and silver skincare devices, comparing the older 'Booster H' model with the new 'Booster Pro' model in a studio-like setting. (8) She applies serum to her face and uses the pink device in 'Booster' mode, moving it across her cheek in circular motions. (9) The woman uses the device in 'EMS' mode, pressing it against her forehead and jawline to demonstrate lifting. (10) She switches to 'MC' mode, applying the device to the delicate skin around her eyes and the nasolabial folds near her mouth. (11) Using the 'Air Shot' mode, she glides the device over her dry skin. (12) Split-screen 'Before and After' shots show side-profile views of her face, highlighting improved skin texture and jawline definition, followed by a demonstration of the device's companion mobile app showing LED settings. (13) The woman speaks final words to the camera, holding the device and pointing toward it as a recommendation.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, high-energy electronic BGM starts immediately with a steady 4/4 rhythm. A female speaker introduces the topic with an animated, friendly tone and high speech rate. (2) A clear splash sound effect is heard as water is dispensed. The speaker's voice maintains consistent clarity and positive valence while describing the ice-water routine. (3) A subtle digital 'whoosh' SFX signals a visual transition between celebrity tips. The BGM tempo remains energetic, providing a continuous bed of sound. (4) A distinctive 'ding' sound effect emphasizes the introduction of the 'Booster Pro' device. The speaker's pitch variability increases to highlight key product features. (5) Rhythmic UI-style beep sounds occur as different treatment modes are selected on the device. The interplay between speech and BGM is balanced, with music clearly audible in the background. (6) The BGM volume swells slightly during the final product demonstration. The speaker concludes with a highly persuasive and cheerful tone, ending with a final bright electronic motif.
